name: TidyCal
tagline: Simple scheduling and paid bookings for $29, once
review_summary: Customers appreciate TidyCal, praising its user-friendly interface, seamless calendar integration, and unbeatable one-time price of $29 for lifetime access. The ability to manage both free and paid bookings effortlessly is a standout feature. There are a couple of minor drawbacks, such as limited customization options and occasional syncing issues, but these have been significantly improved with recent updates. Weighing the raves against the occasional grumbles, TidyCal is hitting the mark and is a solid buy for anyone in need of simple scheduling. With a 60-day money-back guarantee, it's definitely worth giving it a try!

name: kiwilaunch
tagline: Take online bookings and payments, run your business from your iphone
review_summary: Kiwilaunch has received positive feedback for its seamless website integration, user-friendly interface, and responsive customer support. The platform's ease of use, clean design, and efficient payment processing are highly praised. Some users have noted minor drawbacks such as limited customization options and occasional delays in support response times. With an overall rating of 4.6 and positive feedback, Kiwilaunch is a solid buy for those seeking online booking solutions. Plus, with a 60-day money-back guarantee, it's worth giving it a try.

name: Meeting Reminders
tagline: One-click notifications for email, SMS and WhatsApp. And now schedule reminders ahead of time.
review_summary: Customers are all about Meeting Reminders, praising its two-click notifications for email, the ability to schedule reminders ahead of time, and the user-friendly interface. There are a few hiccups like limited integration with other meeting apps. Weighing the raves against the occasional grumbles, Meeting Reminders is hitting the mark and is a solid buy for those in need of efficient meeting notifications. With a 60-day money-back guarantee, it's worth giving it a try!
